extracted.name: Baked Grapefruit with Oatmeal Crumble
extracted.description: I found this recipe online after we received an abundance of grapefruits from the local food pantry that I didn't want to go to waste. I love finding new ways to get my children to eat fruits and vegetables. They really don't like grapefruits much, but this, they were willing to try. Especially when topped with yogurt or whipped cream! 👌😆
ingredient_lines: 1/8 cup oat flour (or standard all-purpose flour)
1 tbsp. melted butter or coconut oil
Greek yogurt and hemp seeds (optional, for topping)
instruction_lines: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Slice the grapefruit in half and use a sharp paring knife to loosen the segments around the inside edges. Place the halves cut-side-up on a baking sheet or baking dish.
In a small mixing bowl, combine the oats, oat flour, chopped walnuts, cinnamon, and salt.
Pour in the melted butter (or coconut oil) and honey, then stir until the mixture is crumbly and moistened.
Evenly divide the oatmeal crumble mixture over the grapefruit halves, pressing it down slightly so it sits on top of the fruit.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until the crumble topping is golden brown and crispy. For extra crispiness, you can broil it for the last 2-3 minutes.
Let it cool for a few minutes, then top with a dollop of Greek yogurt and an extra drizzle of honey if desired.
